استعضن (form X)
# اِسْتَعَضْنَ (istaʕaḍna) /is.ta.ʕadˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعَاضَ (istaʕāḍa)
# اُسْتُعِضْنَ (ustuʕiḍna) /us.tu.ʕidˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعَاضَ (istaʕāḍa)
# اِسْتَعِضْنَ (istaʕiḍna) /is.ta.ʕidˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعَاضَ (istaʕāḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
